## Commit Message Compliance

<!-- This project follows Conventional Commits specification -->

**✅ All commits follow the required format:**
```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>
```

**Allowed types:** `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `security`, `revert`

**Examples:**
- `feat(auth): add OAuth2 support`
- `fix(api): resolve race condition`
- `docs(readme): update installation guide`

⚠️ **Note:** The CI workflow will automatically validate all commit messages. Non-compliant commits will fail the check.
